sources.relevant_excerpt: If you hold a travel document issued by one of the countries or places listed below, you will require a valid Singapore entry visa to travel to, and seek entry, into Singapore. [Listed countries/places:] Afghanistan, Algeria, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bangladesh, Belarus, Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Egypt, Georgia, India, Iran, Iraq, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Kosovo, Kyrgyzstan, Lebanon, Libya, Mali, Moldova, Morocco, Nigeria, Pakistan, Russia, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, Tajikistan, Tunisia, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, Uzbekistan, Yemen. [Also visa-required document types:] Refugee travel documents, Alien's passports, Palestinian Authority passports, temporary UAE passports, Hong Kong SAR Documents of Identity, Macao SAR Travel Permits, PRC Travel Documents. ICA does not accept submission of visa application over the immigration counters. Nationals of the Commonwealth of Independent States, Georgia, India, Turkmenistan and Ukraine; as well as selected Nationals of the People's Republic of China (PRC) ... may be eligible for the Visa-Free Transit Facility. A Singapore entry visa is not an immigration pass. [It is] pre-entry permission [and the] period of stay in Singapore is not tied to the validity of your visa; it is determined by the duration of the Visit Pass issued in the form of electronic visit pass (e-Pass) at the checkpoint upon entry.

[Form 14A may be downloaded from ICA's website.] Visa application can be submitted online [through the SAVE system via a local Singapore contact who is a citizen or Permanent Resident].

sources.relevant_excerpt: All travellers, except Singapore passport holders, must ensure their passport has a minimum validity of 6 months. Short-Term travellers should have sufficient cash and proof of onward travel (tickets, visas). All travellers are required to submit the SG Arrival Card within three (3) days (including the day of arrival) before arriving in Singapore. Short-Term travellers holding a passport or travel document from a visa-required country/region must apply for a Visa [or may use the Visa-Free Transit Facility for stays under 96 hours if eligible]. [Travellers must ensure they] do not stay beyond [their] Visit Pass validity.

sources.relevant_excerpt: Your visa application can be submitted online using the e-Service through a strategic partner or a local contact in Singapore. Your visa application can be submitted at the nearest Singapore Overseas Mission or through its authorised visa agent. A S$30 non-refundable processing fee is payable online using a Visa or MasterCard credit/debit card. Your visa application will be processed within three working days (excluding the day of submission). Some applications may take longer to process. [The e-Service link points to /esvclandingpage/save (SAVE), accessible through MyICA.]

To ensure a smooth journey, travellers seeking to enter Singapore should comply with the general entry   requirements listed below.
General Entry Requirements
Immigration Requirements
To enter Singapore, travellers must meet the following immigration requirements:
i) Travel Documents
All travellers, regardless of age, must hold a valid individually-issued travel document as collective travel documents are not accepted; and
All travellers, except Singapore passport holders, must ensure their passport has a minimum validity of 6 months.
ii) Visa
Short-Term travellers holding a passport or travel document from a visa-required country/region must  apply for a Visa
Visa-required travellers can use the  Visa-Free Transit Facility  for stay of less than 96 hours in Singapore, if eligible

Duly completed Form 14A (PDF, 445KB)

signed by the local contact (if applicable)
Applicant's recent passport-sized colour photograph (taken within the last three months).

from the date of his entry into Singapore
VISA or Master Credit/Debit Card, American Express Card or Internet Banking Details.

policies.policy_name: Singapore entry visa requirement list (negative list; all others visa-exempt)
policies.description: ICA publishes the exhaustive list of countries/places whose travel-document holders require a Singapore entry visa (34 countries plus specified special travel documents). Nationals of all other countries do not require a visa for social/tourist visits. The period of stay is determined by the Visit Pass (e-Pass) issued at the checkpoint upon entry, not by any visa.
conditions: Visa-required countries/places: Afghanistan, Algeria, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bangladesh, Belarus, DPR Korea, Egypt, Georgia, India, Iran, Iraq, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Kosovo, Kyrgyzstan, Lebanon, Libya, Mali, Moldova, Morocco, Nigeria, Pakistan, Russia, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, Tajikistan, Tunisia, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, Uzbekistan, Yemen

Visa-required document types regardless of nationality: refugee travel documents, alien's passports, Palestinian Authority passports, temporary UAE passports, Hong Kong SAR Documents of Identity, Macao SAR Travel Permits, PRC Travel Documents

policies.policy_name: Mutual 30-Day Visa-Exemption Arrangement between Singapore and the People's Republic of China
policies.description: With effect from 9 February 2024, holders of ordinary passports issued by the PRC are exempted from visa requirements for a stay of up to 30 days in Singapore. Holders of all other PRC-issued travel documents must continue to apply for an entry visa before travel.
conditions: Ordinary PRC passports only
PRC diplomatic, public affairs and service passport holders were already exempt under long-standing agreements

policies.policy_name: Singapore entry visa (pre-travel application; issued electronically)
policies.description: Visa-required nationals must obtain a Singapore entry visa before travel. Applications are submitted online via ICA's SAVE e-Service through a local contact in Singapore or an authorised strategic partner/visa agent, or at a Singapore Overseas Mission or through its authorised visa agent. ICA does not accept visa applications at the immigration counters. In China, missions have ceased walk-in applications since 8 December 2014 and applications go through Authorised Visa Agents.
conditions: S$30 non-refundable processing fee (online, Visa or MasterCard credit/debit card)
Processing within three working days excluding day of submission; some applications may take longer
The visa is pre-entry permission; period of stay is set by the Visit Pass (e-Pass) issued on entry

policies.description: Nationals of the Commonwealth of Independent States, Georgia, India, Turkmenistan and Ukraine, as well as selected nationals of the People's Republic of China, may be eligible for visa-free transit through Singapore for up to 96 hours under specific conditions (transit only; not a tourist-entry channel).
conditions: Transit to/from a third country; eligibility subject to specific conditions assessed by ICA
Stays under 96 hours

policies.description: All travellers are required to submit the SG Arrival Card within three days (including the day of arrival) before arriving in Singapore. The SG Arrival Card is not a visa. conditions: Submit within 3 days (including day of arrival) before arriving
Not a visa; does not replace visa requirements
